d: Only in Punjab! This Megatron vs. Optimus Prime-like competition is machine-on-machine action like none other. The huge risk to the driver of these 3000 kg tractors notwithstanding, this extreme tractor sport attracts crowds in thousands. The tractors are tied to each other with a tow chain and pull in opposite directions (tractive effort). The tractor with the losing traction is pulled out of the grounds by the winning tractor. The sport is so extreme that at times the driver of the losing tractor has to leap out of the vehicle before it topples over and crushes him underneath.
